epic.description: Evaluate three gateway options to determine the most suitable solution for our requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Complete technical assessments of all three gateway options
Comparative analysis completed with decision matrix
Implementation roadmap created for selected option

stories.description: Complete technical evaluation of Gateway Option A including architecture, features, performance, and integration capabilities.

subtasks.description: Create comprehensive feature matrix covering all capabilities offered by Gateway Option A

Document integration patterns, APIs, protocols, and compatibility requirements
Evaluate deployment, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance requirements

subtasks.summary: Evaluate Gateway A security and compliance
subtasks.description: Research security features, compliance certifications, and audit capabilities
